point_types.dependency_on_other_points: Independent of other points in the rubrics reviewed.
point_types.does_not_earn: An unsupported numerical value, or a definite integral whose bounds are wrong (sg-22:18).
point_types.earns: A definite integral whose limits match the requested interval and whose integrand matches the requested quantity, with or without the differential (sg-26:4, sg-22:2).
point_types.eligibility_after_error: sg-22:18 states a definite integral with incorrect bounds earns neither this point nor the answer point; sg-22:8 states a definite integral with incorrect limits is not eligible for the answer point.
point_types.name: Definite integral expression with correct limits
point_types.notation_requirements: Differential may be omitted; sg-22:2 accepts dx written for dt. sg-23:8 treats a missing differential as recoverable for this point but restricts later eligibility.
point_types.notes: This family absorbs what would otherwise be a separate limits-of-integration family. Limits are scored inside the integral point or inside the answer point, never as a point of their own.
point_types.precision_rules: Not a reported-value point, so the three-decimal rule does not apply.

point_types.dependency_on_other_points: sg-25:14 and sg-26:20 both state the answer point requires this point first.
point_types.does_not_earn: An antiderivative of the wrong form, or a jump from integral to value with no antiderivative shown (sg-26:18).
point_types.earns: A correct antiderivative of the presented integrand, with or without the constant of integration (sg-25:14).
point_types.eligibility_after_error: sg-23:17 allows an antiderivative of the right form with a wrong constant to earn this point while blocking the answer point; sg-21:11 keeps u-substitution work with unconverted limits eligible for this point.

point_types.does_not_earn: A value outside the accepted precision, or a value inconsistent with a required earlier step where the rubric imposes one.
point_types.earns: The correct value on its own, with no supporting work required (sg-25:3, sg-26:4).
point_types.eligibility_after_error: sg-25:3 treats incorrect or unclear communication between the integral and the answer as scratch work, so bad linkage does not cost this point.
point_types.name: Answer with or without supporting work
point_types.notation_requirements: No special notation requirement stated in the rubrics reviewed.
point_types.precision_rules: A reported decimal answer must be accurate to three places after the decimal point, rounded or truncated; at most one point per question is lost to inappropriate rounding (sg-25:2, sg-26:2). sg-26:4 also accepts a stated rounding to the nearest integer and several truncations.

point_types.dependency_on_other_points: Independent of other points in the rubrics reviewed.
point_types.does_not_earn: An unsupported value (sg-23:10, sg-22:9), or a setup with no value (sg-26:2).
point_types.earns: The correct value together with the setup the prompt demanded, such as a difference and a quotient from a table or an equation that produces the value (sg-26:2, sg-25:4).
point_types.eligibility_after_error: sg-26:11 banks this point once a correct unsimplified expression appears, so later simplification errors do not remove it.
point_types.name: Answer with supporting work or setup shown
point_types.notation_requirements: sg-22:6 withholds this point for an equation of the form function equals constant, such as a derivative expression set equal to a number without evaluation.
point_types.precision_rules: A reported decimal answer must be accurate to three places after the decimal point, rounded or truncated; at most one point per question is lost to inappropriate rounding (sg-25:2, sg-26:2).

point_types.dependency_on_other_points: sg-22:13 allows the units point with an incorrect approximation but not with no presented value.
point_types.does_not_earn: Units with no value present at all where the rubric ties them to a presented value (sg-22:13).
point_types.earns: Correct units, whether or not they are attached to a numerical value (sg-25:11, sg-26:2); equivalent compact forms such as birds per day squared are accepted (sg-26:2).
point_types.eligibility_after_error: No eligibility restriction stated in the rubrics reviewed.

point_types.precision_rules: Not a reported-value point, so the three-decimal rule does not apply.

point_types.dependency_on_other_points: sg-25:19 allows candidate values to be imported from an earlier part, and lets the answer point follow the imported values.
point_types.does_not_earn: A candidates table missing an endpoint (sg-23:15), containing an evaluation error (sg-23:15), or listing extra x-values (sg-25:19).
point_types.earns: A global argument that evaluates the function at every interior critical point and at both endpoints, with the evaluations correct to the stated precision (sg-25:5, sg-25:19).
point_types.eligibility_after_error: sg-22:5 states a correct justification earns its point even when the answer point is lost to a decimal presentation error.
point_types.name: Justification by candidates test
point_types.notation_requirements: No special notation requirement stated in the rubrics reviewed.
point_types.precision_rules: sg-25:5 and sg-25:9 require candidate evaluations correct to the first digit after the decimal, rounded or truncated; sg-22:5 allows up to three decimals or correctly rounded integers.

point_types.dependency_on_other_points: sg-22:5 states a response that misses this point is still eligible for the remaining points of the part.
point_types.does_not_earn: Presenting only the solved critical value, which sg-25:5, sg-25:9, sg-26:17 and sg-25:19 all state is not sufficient.
point_types.earns: Presenting the equation derivative equals zero, or an equivalent equation, or discussing the sign change of the derivative, or using the phrase critical points of the function (sg-25:5, sg-26:17).
